text: and then one more thing. in 3d.zig how much of the line count is comments vs actual code
resolution: Counted framework/gpu/3d.zig using a line-aware Zig comment scan and independently cross-checked the result with tokei. The 16,083 physical lines divide into 12,791 code-bearing lines, 2,572 comment-only lines, and 720 blank lines; 288 of the code-bearing lines additionally contain an inline comment. No repository files were changed.
